newsitem.title: USA: First Oak stake cut by Basswood group.
newsitem.headline: First Oak stake cut by Basswood group.

text.p: A group including Basswood Partners L.P., a New Jersey-based investment firm, said Tuesday it cut its stake in First Oak Brook Bancshares Inc. to 80,141 class A common shares, or 4.32 percent, from 172,641 shares, or 9.38 percent.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold a net 92,500 shares between Dec. 31, 1996 and Jan. 30, 1997 at prices ranging from $23.38 to $23.50 a share.
As a holder of less than 5 percent of the company, the group is no longer required to report further dealings in the company's stock to the SEC.
